knowledgeStates.name: known
knowledgeStates.meaning: The proposition is established for the named anchor and validity scope by admissible evidence or a proved terminal postcondition.

knowledgeStates.name: estimated
knowledgeStates.meaning: The proposition is supported by a declared derivation or model with explicit uncertainty and operating-envelope limits.

knowledgeStates.name: unknown
knowledgeStates.meaning: The authorized evidence acquired so far does not establish the proposition.

knowledgeStates.name: conflicted
knowledgeStates.meaning: Material admissible evidence supports incompatible propositions or generations.

knowledgeStates.name: stale
knowledgeStates.meaning: The proposition was valid only at an older anchor or generation and has not been revalidated.

knowledgeStates.name: not_observable
knowledgeStates.meaning: The declared sensor/authorization/model domain could not have established the proposition for the requested interval.

knowledgeStates.name: redacted
knowledgeStates.meaning: The proposition or its evidence exists but is intentionally withheld by the current privacy/capability projection.

knowledgeStates.name: indeterminate
knowledgeStates.meaning: A consequential external outcome may have occurred but is not yet proved or safely negated.

knowledgeStates.name: not_applicable
knowledgeStates.meaning: The proposition has no meaning for the named object, scope, or lifecycle state.

provenanceClasses.name: observed
provenanceClasses.meaning: Directly supported by canonical sensor, device, operator, or effect evidence.

provenanceClasses.name: derived
provenanceClasses.meaning: Deterministically computed from named canonical inputs under a registered algorithm and generation.

provenanceClasses.name: predicted
provenanceClasses.meaning: Counterfactual or forward prediction under an explicit branch/model and assumptions.

provenanceClasses.name: remembered
provenanceClasses.meaning: Advisory operational memory or prior episode material that must be revalidated against live evidence.

provenanceClasses.name: operator_asserted
provenanceClasses.meaning: A human/operator assertion with identity, time, scope, and later corroboration status.

provenanceClasses.name: vendor_claimed
provenanceClasses.meaning: Metadata or state asserted by a device/vendor boundary and not treated as independent physical truth.

provenanceClasses.name: policy
provenanceClasses.meaning: A rule, threshold, capability, or privacy decision from an exact policy generation.

responsePriority: possibly occurred or indeterminate effects and overdue obligations
decision-changing evidence, contradictions, coverage loss, and invalidated assumptions
optional detail reachable through stable handles and continuations

objectComposition.MissionContract: contains one ObjectiveContract and immutable revisions of focus, assumptions, budgets, and terminal criteria
objectComposition.SituationCapsule: contains a SituationFrame with a WorldEnvelope, optional MeaningfulDelta, active investigations/plans/obligations, resource state, a categorized control envelope, ContextPack, and SemanticCompressionReceipt
objectComposition.InvestigationCase: contains or references a HypothesisWorkspace, discriminating probes, stop rules, findings, and residual uncertainty
objectComposition.ControlPlan: contains a witnessed contingent DAG and prepared domain effects; it never confers authority by itself
objectComposition.ExperienceCapsule: summarizes one or more ExecutionEpisodes and can produce advisory FeedbackProposal or LearningProposal objects
objectComposition.HandoffCapsule: publishes the minimum sufficient mission/workspace/case/plan/obligation state as a root-last portable graph
objectComposition.AgentResponseEnvelope: wraps every public operation result with exact contract basis, lifecycle/effect boundary, recovery class, proof, budget, continuation, affordances, and one typed semantic payload
objectComposition.WorldEnvelope: separates the nominal world, certified core and absences, material alternative worlds, adversarial residuals, common invariants, unresolved dimensions, and discriminating affordances
objectComposition.AgentRequestEnvelope: wraps every public operation request with exact contract basis, lifecycle identity, anchor/workspace preconditions, budgets, requested authority/privacy projection, continuation, taint, and one typed semantic payload
objectComposition.ContractBasis: freezes the exact semantic protocol, schema catalog, ontology, operation/view/capability/error/cost registries, and producing release for portable interpretation
objectComposition.AgentCognitiveEnvelope: carries generic decision semantics and effective epistemic/coverage/budget/affordance state inside the universal AgentResponseEnvelope

responseComposition.rule: SituationCapsule is the primary orient/resume publication and contains the mission-relative SituationFrame plus meaningful delta, obligations, resource state, affordances, and context/compression proof. AgentCognitiveEnvelope is the general decision-bearing semantic payload. AgentResponseEnvelope adds lifecycle/retry/budget/proof/continuation framing without redefining meaning.
responseComposition.effectiveProjection: AgentResponseEnvelope reports effectiveViewId, effectiveCapabilities, effectivePrivacyProjection, taskState, and payloadDigest; requested authority is never presumed effective.

semanticCompressionRule: Every lossy ContextPack carries a SemanticCompressionReceipt; contradictions, not-observable domains, effect indeterminacy, hard clamps, and mission-critical obligations are non-droppable.

worldEnvelopeDoctrine.evidenceEnvelope: what the named anchor and coverage witnesses positively establish, including certified absences
worldEnvelopeDoctrine.possibilityEnvelope: material alternative and adversarial worlds still compatible with evidence, authorization, and observability limits
worldEnvelopeDoctrine.controlEnvelope: actions robust across the envelope, actions conditional on named worlds, information-gathering actions, wait/watch actions, and blocked actions
worldEnvelopeDoctrine.monotonicity: a successor envelope may shrink, split, or expand as evidence and coverage change; it may not erase a protected high-consequence residual without a named witness or explicit scope/policy decision
worldEnvelopeDoctrine.decisionRule: irreversible or high-consequence effects require robustness across all protected plausible worlds or an explicit policy-authorized branch with current discriminating evidence

recoveryClasses.name: never_unchanged
recoveryClasses.meaning: Do not repeat the same request blindly; inspect or reconcile first.

recoveryClasses.name: safe_read_retry
recoveryClasses.meaning: The read can be repeated at the same semantic intent, subject to current budget.

recoveryClasses.name: refresh_and_retry
recoveryClasses.meaning: Refresh the named stale generation or anchor before repeating.

recoveryClasses.name: rebase_required
recoveryClasses.meaning: Recompile the query, case, or plan against a new workspace/world basis.

recoveryClasses.name: backoff
recoveryClasses.meaning: Retry only after the supplied pressure/dependency condition or deadline.

recoveryClasses.name: reconciliation_required
recoveryClasses.meaning: Look up and prove the possibly executed external/durable outcome before any retry.

recoveryClasses.name: operator_action_required
recoveryClasses.meaning: A human approval, credential, physical step, or policy change is required.

recoveryClasses.name: resume_from_continuation
recoveryClasses.meaning: Resume from the returned durable cursor/task/capsule rather than restarting.

requestResponseRule: Every AOP operation accepts AgentRequestEnvelope and returns AgentResponseEnvelope. The server intersects requested authority/privacy/view with current policy and reports the effective projection explicitly. Operation-specific payload schemas and retry classes are declared only in architecture/agent_operations.json.

subsystemProjectionContract.name: CognitiveFacet
subsystemProjectionContract.compositionRule: a SituationCapsule is composed only from capability-projected facets pinned to one compatible version universe; the compositor may select and connect facts but may not redefine a facet owner’s semantics
subsystemProjectionContract.forbidden: subsystem-specific free-form agent replies, hidden ambient reads, unversioned side chronologies, or direct effect authority in a facet
